# ETH-USD close on 2026-09-30: research brief (information as of 2026-09-09)

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the daily close of ETH-USD on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-30, a Wednesday. Crypto trades every day, so there will be a close on that date. Yahoo dates its crypto closes by the UTC day.
- 2026-09-08: Latest Yahoo close was 2,484.94 (from the code-collected data). I could not fetch Yahoo directly.
- 2026-09-09: Fortune's daily snapshot showed ETH at $2,487.92, so the price is roughly flat against the Yahoo close. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-09-2026/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. ETH is about 2,485, close to the middle of the 1,500 to 4,000 range, with three weeks left.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-08: Fortune put ETH at $2,471.99. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-08-2026/)
- 2026-09-07: ETH opened about $2,515 and later fell to about $2,498. A "bombastic" August jobs report on Friday raised expectations of a Fed rate *hike* this month. Traders were watching the August CPI and PPI releases. [edgeX](https://pro.edgex.exchange/en-US/news/article/bitcoin-ethereum-prices-inflation-data-fed)
- 2026-09-06: ETH rose above $2,490, helped by ETF demand. [Sunday Guardian](https://sundayguardianlive.com/business/ethereum-price-today-06-september-eth-climbs-above-2490-as-etf-demand-and-softer-fed-rate-expectations-support-recovery-check-latest-ethereum-prices-in-usd-inr-gbp-euro-jpy-278731/)
- Early September: A futures market preview said traders were pricing a 70%+ chance of a September Fed hike, which would be the first since 2023. [investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stock-market-update/preview-august-cpi-due-friday-to-decide-odds-of-first-fed-hike-since-2023/)
- 2026-09-02: ETH was $2,377.98, about $1,950 lower than a year earlier. Fortune linked the early-2026 drop to recession fears and sales by Vitalik Buterin. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-02-2026/)
- Through 2026-09-02: A promotional source said spot ETH ETFs had 12 straight days of inflows totaling about $1.62B. [openPR](https://www.openpr.com/news/4631126/ethereum-price-prediction-september-2026-eth-etfs-pull-1-62)
- August 2026: ETH gained about 32.6% for the month, after +18.5% in July. Sources disagree, with figures ranging from 32% to 40%. Spot ETH ETFs took in about $824M in the week ending Aug 28, their biggest weekly inflow of 2026. ETH was around $1,900 in early August and got back above $2,000 by Aug 20. That day's move was a short squeeze after US Treasury buyback news. BTC rose about 24% in August and briefly went above $80K. [Analytics Insight](https://www.analyticsinsight.net/cryptocurrency-analytics-insight/what-to-expect-from-ethereum-price-in-september-2026), [Pluang](https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/harga-ethereum-eth-tom-lee-fundstrat-target-konservatif-6000), [ms-aktuell](https://ms-aktuell.de/welt/ethereum-2000-dollar-20-08-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- The code's baseline, built from 22-day returns over the last 3 years, gives these percentiles for the Sept 30 price:

| Percentile | Price (USD) |
|---|---|
| p5 | 1,866 |
| p10 | 2,015 |
| p25 | 2,246 |
| p50 | 2,481 |
| p75 | 2,740 |
| p90 | 3,141 |
| p95 | 3,325 |

- The p25 to p75 band is roughly ±10% around today's price. The p5 to p95 band runs from about -25% to +34%.
- Seasonality: ETH has averaged about -6.84% in September over the last ten years. September is historically a weak month. [Analytics Insight](https://www.analyticsinsight.net/cryptocurrency-analytics-insight/what-to-expect-from-ethereum-price-in-september-2026)
- Momentum: ETH has risen about 60% since early August. That is strong upward momentum, but after a run that big, sharp pullbacks are also possible.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market for ETH's price at the end of September, quoted on or before 2026-09-09. Polymarket does run daily "ETH price on [date]" markets, but I did not find pre-Sept-9 prices for the Sept 30 market.
- Before Sept 9, Polymarket's year-end markets were mixed. Bitcoin.com reported only a 17% chance that ETH reaches $3,000 in 2026. Coinotag reported a 70% chance of touching $3,000. Both articles are undated in my results, so I could not confirm when either figure was quoted. [Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/polymarket-bettors-give-ethereum-just-a-17-shot-at-reaching-3000-in-2026/), [Coinotag](https://en.coinotag.com/polymarket-ethereum-eth-3000-touch-odds-70)
- One forecast site projected a September 2026 range of $2,677 to $3,166, averaging $2,953. That is a low-quality, model-generated projection. [LiteFinance](https://www.litefinance.org/blog/analysts-opinions/ethereum-price-prediction-forecast/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Week of 2026-09-07: August PPI comes out.
- 2026-09-11: August CPI is released at 8:30 ET. Consensus is about +0.38% headline and +0.22% core month on month. This release is seen as deciding whether the Fed hikes. [investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stock-market-update/preview-august-cpi-due-friday-to-decide-odds-of-first-fed-hike-since-2023/)
- 2026-09-15/16: The FOMC meets, with a rate decision and new projections. A hike would be the first since 2023 and is a significant risk for crypto.
- Ongoing: Daily spot ETH ETF flows, tracked by Farside and SoSoValue, and oil-driven pressure on bond yields.
- Glamsterdam upgrade: mainnet is targeted for Q4 2026 with no date set. Testnet forks are expected in October, so the upgrade is unlikely to be a direct catalyst before Sept 30. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/ethereum-s-glamsterdam-upgrade-enters-final-testnet-phase-ahead-of-q4-2026-mainnet-target), [investingLive](https://investinglive.com/education/glamsterdam-in-plain-english-how-ethereum-plans-to-cut-out-the-middlemen-in-block-building/)
- End of quarter on 2026-09-30, plus the usual monthly and quarterly options and futures expiry around Sept 25 on Deribit and CME.
